name: INOX India Ltd
title: INOX India Ltd - 544046 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Record FY26 revenue of INR1,632 crore (+21.2%) and order book INR1,514 crore, but operating cash flow has lagged sales as project contract assets build; management guides 18-20% FY27 growth without numeric capex or capacity changes beyond Kandla.

capex.quote: we are developing a new facility at Kandla. We have acquired approximately 7 acres of land near the Kandla Port on a 30-year lease basis

triggers.label: Operating cash flow lagging sales
triggers.quote: Today on sales of INR1,587 crores, cash flow from operations is INR116 crores.

triggers.label: Kandla facility to add ultra-large tank capacity
triggers.quote: The Kandla facility will substantially enhance our capability to manufacture ultra large tanks

triggers.label: Q4 order from US aerospace ~INR200 crore
triggers.quote: we received a significant aerospace order from a leading U.S. based private space company with a total order value of approximately INR200 crores

guidance.value: INR450 crores to INR500 crores every quarter
guidance.quote: our order booking will be also growing in the similar speed of around INR450 crores to INR500 crores every quarter.
at least INR1,200 crores will be executed this year.

red_flags.label: Operating cash flow falling as sales rise
red_flags.quote: Today on sales of INR1,587 crores, cash flow from operations is INR116 crores.

red_flags.label: Working capital up from INR731 to INR990 crore
red_flags.quote: It used to be INR731 crores by FY '25, it has gone up to INR990 crore.

red_flags.label: MSRTC receivable/payment difficulty
red_flags.quote: the payment terms and other things are also very difficult with that party

evasions.quote: For to comment on this, wait for some time for this.
Anyways Pavan-ji, we'll take it offline.
